title: Glowing roller skate
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx='48' cy='62' rx='40' ry='26' fill='#3a1f5c' opacity='0.35'/>
  <!-- boot body -->
  <path d='M28 20 L58 20 L60 30 L64 44 L66 52 L30 54 L26 40 Z' fill='#ff5da8'/>
  <!-- boot lighter panels -->
  <path d='M30 22 L44 22 L45 38 L32 40 Z' fill='#ff9ccb'/>

  <path d='M27 18 L59 18 L60 23 L28 23 Z' fill='#ffe14d'/>
  <!-- laces -->
  <rect x='40' y='28' width='14' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#8affe0'/>
  <rect x='41' y='34' width='15' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#8affe0'/>
  <rect x='42' y='40' width='16' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#8affe0'/>
  <!-- cuff highlight -->
  <path d='M28 24 L60 24 L60 27 L28 27 Z' fill='#ffb3d9'/>
  <!-- sole -->
  <path d='M26 52 L68 50 L70 58 L26 60 Z' fill='#ff8a3d'/>
  <path d='M26 60 L70 58 L70 63 L26 65 Z' fill='#d9641c'/>

  <rect x='58' y='62' width='12' height='8' rx='2' fill='#ffb347'/>

  <circle cx='38' cy='74' r='9' fill='#8f5cff'/>

  <circle cx='62' cy='74' r='9' fill='#8f5cff'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='74' r='4' fill='#d9c2ff'/>
  <!-- toe stop -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='68' r='6' fill='#ff5da8'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='68' r='2.5' fill='#ffd0e6'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <path d='M76 24 l2 5 5 2 -5 2 -2 5 -2 -5 -5 -2 5 -2 Z' fill='#ffe14d'/>
  <path d='M16 20 l1.5 4 4 1.5 -4 1.5 -1.5 4 -1.5 -4 -4 -1.5 4 -1.5 Z' fill='#8affe0'/>
</svg>
